explanation: Backtrack over valid prefixes, adding an opening parenthesis while pairs remain and a closing one only when an unmatched opening exists. Prefix strings are copied at each step.
spaceComplexity: O(n²) worst-case active prefix strings, plus O(n·Cₙ) output
